title: Numbered Shopping List
prompt: items = ["milk", "bread", "eggs"] is given. Print each on its own line as 1. milk / 2. bread / 3. eggs — use enumerate so numbering is automatic.

tests.name: numbered output
tests.code:
assert printed == ["1. milk", "2. bread", "3. eggs"], f"got {printed}"
assert "enumerate(" in code, "use enumerate() for numbering"
tests.hint: for i, item in enumerate(items, start=1): print(f"{i}. {item}")
